page.layout: One page of running text in one column, set left of centre, with musical notation figures placed inline between lines. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: da sursum, sive deorsum trahatur hoc mo-do: [illegible, ~5 letters]
Punctus à tergo notulis ascriptus, di-midio eas valore adhuc auget: [illegible, ~7 letters]
Prima carens cauda longa est, pendente secunda, [illegible, ~4 letters]
Prima carens cauda lōga est, scanden-te secunda, [illegible, ~4 letters]
Estq; brevis, caudam si læva parte re-mittit, [illegible, ~4 letters]
Semibrevis fertur sursum si duxerit illam, [illegible, ~3 letters]

page.notes: The musical notation figures (mensural note shapes, with stems, dots and ligatures) cannot be rendered as text; each group is marked as illegible with an approximate count, and their position is kept inline. The "Cedò" at the lower right is cut off by the right edge of the scan, so the text there may continue beyond the image. The long s has been normalised to s, and u/v and i/j to modern usage, as the rules require. "Estq;" is kept as printed.
